title: Prototypes and this
summary: How JavaScript objects really share behaviour - the prototype chain under classes, Object.create, own versus inherited properties, the four rules for this, losing this when passing methods, and fixing it with arrow functions and bind.

cards.q: Where does a class's method live: on each instance or once on the prototype?
cards.a: Once on ClassName.prototype; every instance finds it through the prototype chain.
The method is called later on its own, so this is undefined instead of obj; pass () => obj.method() or obj.method.bind(obj).
